test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance from commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the given statements.

Statements:

1. Some desks are tables.

II. All tables are cabinets.

III. All cabinets are beds.

Conclusions:

I. Some beds are tables.

II. All cabinets are desks.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows.

solution:
Lease possible Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a727cfa56736bc07c09f1a4c4d9094bcff8806a075ebb1cf93d19df855e37d5.png] 

Conclusions:

 1. Some beds are tables → Follow (All tables are cabinets and all cabinets are bed. so, some beds are definitely tables).

2. All cabinets are desks → Does not follow (There is no direct relation given between cabinets and desks).

Only conclusion 1 follows.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 1”.
